_doc: Surgical dilemmas (SurgicalDilemmas): decision complications that stop the operation and ask what you do. At most one per operation, never while learning. Chance rises with risk: neural load, black-market or unknown chrome, existing chrome, hidden conditions, emergencies, poor tools; skill lowers it. weight_when: extra weight per condition. Each choice: odds (base success; + surgeon skill; + tool tier for 'tool'; staff uses the employee's chance), requires {tool: category, parts, supplies, staff}, risk (what you're told), success / fail outcomes: vitals (health, neural, blood, bleed_rate, pain), perf (implant performance x), pay (pay x), abort (stop safely), find (an implant you pull out), stress (employee), memory (patient remembers), text.

dilemmas.title: NEURAL REJECTION DETECTED
dilemmas.text: The host nerve bundle is rejecting the interface. Signal is collapsing at the junction.

choices.label: PUSH THROUGH
choices.risk: Might hold. If not: neural damage.

fail.text: The junction burns. The patient seizes.

choices.label: NEURAL DAMPENER (INJECTOR)
choices.risk: Needs an injector. Better odds with better tools.

success.text: The dampener smooths the spike out.

choices.label: CALL A RIPPERDOC IN
choices.risk: Uses your employee's skill. Adds stress to them.

success.text: Two pairs of hands keep the bundle alive.

fail.text: Even together you lose part of the signal.

choices.label: STOP THE OPERATION
choices.risk: Patient lives. No chrome, no pay.

success.text: You back out and close up.

dilemmas.title: UNKNOWN FIRMWARE
dilemmas.text: The implant is broadcasting a handshake nobody registered. Something in the firmware wants to talk to the network.

choices.label: FLASH IT CLEAN (2 PARTS)
choices.risk: Costs parts. Fails badly sometimes: bricked chrome.

success.text: Wiped and rebuilt. It's quiet now.

fail.text: The flash bricked half the board.

choices.label: INSTALL IT AS IS
choices.risk: Faster, more pay. It might be phoning someone.

success.text: It goes in. The handshake stops. For now.

fail.text: It pings something. Somebody knows where you are now.

choices.label: SWAP TO A SAFER PROCEDURE
choices.risk: Safe. The chrome will run at reduced capacity; pay drops.

success.text: You isolate it on a dumb bus. It works, slowly.

dilemmas.title: INTERNAL BLEEDING
dilemmas.text: Pressure's dropping and it isn't from your incision. Something deeper opened up.

choices.label: OPEN UP AND CLAMP IT
choices.risk: Skill matters. Fail and they lose a lot of blood.

fail.text: You found the wrong vessel first.

choices.label: IGNORE IT AND FINISH FAST
choices.risk: Gamble with their life. Big trouble if it goes wrong.

dilemmas.title: CYBERWARE INSTABILITY
dilemmas.text: Their existing chrome is fighting the new unit: two power buses, one body, sparks under the skin.

choices.label: REROUTE WITH THE SPLICER
choices.risk: Needs a splicer. Better odds with better tools.

success.text: The bridge holds and the chrome runs hotter than spec.

fail.text: The bridge cooks a nerve cluster.

choices.label: STOP AND CLOSE UP
choices.risk: Patient lives. No chrome, no pay.

dilemmas.title: UNEXPECTED NERVE DAMAGE
dilemmas.text: An old injury nobody mentioned: the nerve you need is already half dead.

choices.label: GRAFT AROUND IT
choices.risk: Slow, skilled work. Fail and there's lasting damage.

fail.text: They'll have a tremor for life.

choices.label: CALL A RIPPERDOC IN
choices.risk: Uses your employee's skill. Adds stress to them.

success.text: Your ripperdoc has steadier hands for this one.

fail.text: Neither of you could save the nerve.

success.text: It'll work. Not like the brochure.

dilemmas.title: FOREIGN DEVICE DETECTED
dilemmas.text: There's something already in there that isn't on any chart: a sealed module wired into the spine, no serial, still warm.

choices.label: EXTRACT IT
choices.risk: You keep what you pull out. Fail and it fights back.

success.text: It comes out in one piece. Heavy. Military?

fail.text: It discharges as you cut. The patient convulses.

choices.label: WORK AROUND IT
choices.risk: Leave it alone. Slower, slightly worse fit.

success.text: You route around it. None of your business.

fail.text: You nick its housing. Something beeps.

choices.label: STOP. THIS IS TROUBLE
choices.risk: Patient lives. No chrome, no pay.

success.text: You close up and tell them nothing.
